    "originalFile": "% Section 7 — Discussion and Conclusion (compressed)\n% Full discussion paragraphs moved to Appendix B.\n\n\\paragraph{CF Severity.}\n% exp_ids: phase2_scierc_full_s1 (CF=9.90%), phase2_scierc_grammar_only (CF=0.08%),\n%          phase2_docred_full_s1 (CF=2.57%), llama_docred_full_s1 (CF=12.02%)\nDR violations produce ontologically invalid triples that no downstream system can recover from.\nCF violations are qualitatively milder: each triple remains type-valid per its own relation; only cross-triple consistency is broken.\nThe dominant pattern---\\emph{Generic}$\\leftrightarrow$\\emph{OtherScientificTerm} (85/245 on SciERC; Table~\\ref{tab:cf-distribution})---reflects genuine type-system ambiguity; conflicts involving \\textsc{Generic} account for 63.3\\% of all CF violations.\nAblation attributes CF to the semantic layer: grammar-only yields CF\\,=\\,0.08\\% (matching unconstrained), while the full system reaches 9.90\\% on SciERC and 2.57\\% on DocRED (12.02\\% for Llama), confirming that CF arises from per-relation independent enforcement (Appendix~\\ref{app:discussion}).\n% exp_ids: phase2_scierc_grammar_only, phase2_docred_full_s1, llama_docred_full_s1\n\n\\paragraph{Dataset-Dependent F1 Impact.}\n% exp_ids: d012_bootstrap_ci (DocRED +0.50pp p<0.001, SciERC +0.13pp p=0.58),\n%          phase0_docred_unconstrained (RV=29.66%), phase0_scierc_unconstrained (RV=1.39%)\nThe F1 divergence between DocRED ($+$0.50\\,pp, $p < 0.001$) and SciERC ($+$0.13\\,pp, $p = 0.58$) traces to grammar-layer OOV elimination: DocRED's 29.66\\% baseline RV produces 5{,}189 false positives whose removal yields a significant precision gain; SciERC's 1.39\\% RV (24 OOV predictions) is too low to produce a detectable effect.\nLlama's lower RV (16.03\\%) yields a proportionally smaller gain ($+$0.29\\,pp), confirming that F1 improvement scales with baseline OOV rate.\n% exp_ids: phase0_docred_unconstrained, phase0_scierc_unconstrained\n% exp_ids: llama_docred_unconstrained (RV=16.03%), llama_docred_full_s1 (R-F1 delta=+0.29pp)\n\n\\paragraph{Contributions.}\n% exp_ids: phase2_scierc_full_s1, phase2_docred_full_s1, llama_docred_full_s1\nWe presented OntoCoDec, a framework compiling IE ontology schemas into token-level decoding constraints, and conducted the first systematic study of ontological constraint violations in LLM-based IE.\nOur two-layer architecture achieves 45--99\\% DR reduction across two models and two datasets, with significant R-F1 gains on DocRED ($p \\leq 0.013$) and model-dependent entity F1 impact.\n\n% Limitations and Future Work moved to \\section*{Limitations} in main.tex (ARR requirement)\n",
